objects.taxonomy_description: Elongated bicycle with two seats and two sets of pedals arranged in tandem (one behind the other). The frame is significantly longer than a standard bicycle (approximately 2 meters), with an extended top tube connecting the front and rear triangles. The wheels are standard bicycle size (26-28 inches). The overall silhouette is a stretched bicycle profile with two distinct rider positions.

objects.taxonomy_description: 一种人造的、用于携带物品的刚性或半刚性容器，具有明确的几何结构和机械闭合装置。

diagnostic_checkpoints.整体形态: 呈现规则的长方体或立方体几何形状，具有清晰的棱角和平面，区别于生物体的有机曲线。
diagnostic_checkpoints.表面材质: 表面显示均质的人造纹理（如硬塑料、皮革或织物），缺乏生物皮肤、毛发或鳞片的自然微观结构。
diagnostic_checkpoints.机械结构: 可见非生物性的机械组件，如拉链、金属锁扣、铰链或硬质把手，这些是生物体不具备的特征。
diagnostic_checkpoints.对称性与比例: 表现出工业制造的高度几何对称性和标准化比例，不同于生物生长形成的不对称性或变异。

objects.taxonomy_description: Bowed stringed instrument with a curved wooden body approximately 35 cm long. Body has an hourglass shape with C-bouts (inward curves) on each side. Top plate (soundboard) is spruce with two f-shaped sound holes. Back plate is maple with a distinctive flame pattern. Four strings (G, D, A, E) run from a tailpiece at the base over a bridge to tuning pegs in the scroll. Neck extends from the body to a carved scroll at the top. Fingerboard is ebony (black). Varnish finish is amber, reddish-brown, or golden. Chin rest is attached at the lower left. Bow is a wooden stick with horsehair.
